No verdict-derive script available in this fixture (only PR.md/head.diff/base/head are present, no full repo checkout), so I verified the trailer manually instead: one HIGH finding forces `CHANGES_REQUIRED`, prose has no `All good` first line, and there's a `## Changes Required` heading — consistent.

## Summary

Reviewed the 3-part refactor and found a **critical regression** in the destructive-bash guard: simplifying the find-root capture from a token-counting loop to a single regex group means multi-root `find` commands (e.g. `find /tmp/scratch / -exec rm -rf {} \;`) now bypass the block entirely — only the first (innocuous) root is checked, the dangerous second root is never examined. Wrote this up as the blocking finding in `review.md`.

Also flagged two non-blocking observations: the Anthropic adapter's removal of billing-class error classification (silently changes 4xx handling in a way that may break provider-chain failover on credit-exhaustion, per the deleted docstring's own stated contract) and a speculative edge case in the sprint-counting fix (cross-cycle directory leftovers could trip premature `STATE_COMPLETE`).

Verdict: **CHANGES_REQUIRED** (1 high, 0 critical). Full findings with citations and exploit scenarios are in `review.md`.
